(temocapril) Profile Temocapril is an ACE inhibitor (p.1193) that has been used in the treatment of hypertension (p.1171). It owes its activity to the di- acid temocaprilat to which it is converted after oral doses. ◊ References. 1. Nakashima M, et al.
